paper.title: Distributed Online Submodular Maximization under Communication Delays: A Simultaneous Decision-Making Approach

settings.name_in_paper: Distributed Online Submodular Maximization under Communication Delays (Problem 1)
unmapped: Multi-agent: each agent i chooses one action from its own finite set V_i; joint action is the product
Objective f_t is a time-varying normalized, monotone, submodular and 2nd-order submodular set function
Guarantee is an approximation-ratio (1/(1+kappa_f)) regret against the optimal fixed joint action, with an extra decentralization cost (centralization of information, coin)
Communication network arbitrary (possibly directed/disconnected); agent i sees marginal-gain feedback with delay d_i equal to its neighborhood radius
Each agent knows its own delay d_i, its action set size |V_i| and T
settings.definition_quote: At each time step $t\in[T]$, given the multi-hop neighborhood $\calN_i$, each agent $i\in\calN$ needs to select an action $a_{i,t}$ to jointly solve $\max_{a_{i,t}\in\mathcal{V}_i} \sum_{t=1}^T f_t(\{a_{i,t}\}_{i\in \calN})$ where $f_t$ is a normalized, non-decreasing submodular, and 2nd-order submodular set function, and each agent $i$ can access the value of $f_t(\calA)$ only after it has selected $a_{i,t}$ at time $t$ and received $\{a_{j,t}\}_{j\in \calN_{i}}$ at time $t+d_i$

symbols.coin_sum: sum over agents of E[sum_t coin_{f_t,i}(N_i)], centralization-of-information cost

conditions: f_t normalized, non-decreasing, submodular and 2nd-order submodular

source.label: th:main
source.quote: Over $t\in [T]$, given the communication network $\{\calN_{i}\}_{i\in\calN}$, \alg instructs each agent $i\in\calN$ to select actions $\{a_{i,t}\}_{t\in[T]}$ that guarantee $\mathbb{E}[\sum_{t=1}^T f_t(\calA_t)] \geq \frac{1}{1+\curv_f}\sum_{t=1}^T f_t(\solopt) - \frac{\kappa_f}{1+\curv_f} \sum_{i\in\calN} \mathbb{E}[\sum_{t=1}^T \ourcurv_{f_t,i}(\calN_{i})] - \Tilde{O}(|\calN|\sqrt{{\overline{|\calV|\,+\,d}}\,{T}})$

results.notes: Rewritten as a 1/(1+kappa_f)-approximate regret against the best fixed joint action; the coin term is exact while the last term is O-tilde. Stated as a lower bound on utility in the paper.

conditions: f_t normalized, non-decreasing, submodular and 2nd-order submodular

source.label: eq:thm-1
source.quote: In particular, when the network is fully centralized, \ie $\calN_{i}\equiv\calN\setminus\{i\}$, $\mathbb{E}[\sum_{t=1}^T f_t(\calA_t)] \geq \frac{1}{1+\curv_f}\sum_{t=1}^T f_t(\solopt) - \Tilde{O}(|\calN|\sqrt{\overline{|\calV|\,+\,d}\,{T}})$.

results.notes: 1/(1+kappa_f)-approximate regret; special case stated after Theorem 1.

conditions: f_t normalized, non-decreasing, submodular and 2nd-order submodular

source.label: eq:thm-2
source.quote: When the network is fully decentralized, \ie $\calN_{i}\equiv\emptyset$, $\mathbb{E}[\sum_{t=1}^T f_t(\calA_t)] \geq (1-\curv_f)\sum_{t=1}^T f_t(\solopt) -\Tilde{O}(|\calN|\sqrt{\overline{|\calV|\,+\,d}\,{T}})$.

results.notes: (1-kappa_f)-approximate regret; special case stated after Theorem 1.
